Downloads & privacy

Free local models download from Hugging Face and can be cached by your browser. Documents stay on this device. Runtime downloads add to the sizes above.

About Google & Microsoft

Gemini Embedding 2 is a hosted API, not a downloadable local model in this app. PowerToys Text Extractor is a Windows tool. This site uses free local Tesseract OCR instead.

Google model documentation ↗

OCR loads local engine files and ~3 MB English data when needed. PDF OCR runs on pages without selectable text. Recognition can contain errors; inspect source text.

Generate answers / WebLLM

Active: evidence only. WebGPU is required for generation.

Answer model card & files ↗WebLLM docs ↗
Model guidance & compatibility

Capability guidance is qualitative, not measured accuracy. Larger models can still hallucinate. Weight sizes exclude tokenizer/runtime downloads. GPU memory estimates are approximate.

Loads only when you click download. Weights download from Hugging Face; compiled model libraries from MLC on GitHub. Your questions and documents stay in this browser. Cached models can be evicted by the browser. Use a current WebGPU-enabled Chrome or Edge with a compatible GPU.

02 / UNDER THE HOOD

Inspectable by design

Useful AI needs
more than a prompt.

Evidence Lab makes the retrieval layer visible. Change the corpus, inspect a result, or run the evaluation. The behavior is yours to test.

01

Ingest & chunk

PDF, text, and Markdown become overlapping word windows. Each chunk keeps its document name and PDF page number.

document → source chunks
02

Retrieve & rank

Choose BM25, local embeddings, or RRF hybrid retrieval. Adjustable chunk sizes and retrieval depth let you explore the tradeoffs.

query → ranked evidence
03

Cite & inspect

Inspect source excerpts or load a local WebLLM for a generated answer with citations. No evidence means no generation.

evidence → optional local LLM → citations
ENGINEERING NOTE

BM25 is instant; local MiniLM or BGE embeddings can match related meaning after a model download. OCR reads scanned pages locally. Similarity scores are not confidence, and extracted evidence still needs human review. Optional WebLLM generation turns retrieved passages into a cited answer using your GPU. Generated claims and citation accuracy need human review.
